recent.title: Lint Prioritisation — Not Every Warning Needs a Fix
recent.summary: James directed that lint findings be prioritised by business impact, not fixed blindly. Four-question test: customers? memory/reasoning? execution? trust? No to all = log, schedule, move on.

recent.title: Complete Business State — Task Is Not Complete Until All Systems Updated
recent.summary: Atlas was treating email sends as complete when the email was sent. James: 'Airtable should never be forgotten to update.' business_knowledge.description: Permanent business principles. Every completed experiment contributes one. Not documents — knowledge that defines how Not Forgotten operates.

principles.principle: Painters do not respond meaningfully to curiosity-led outreach about quote follow-up.
principles.evidence: 105 prospects, zero meaningful replies across curiosity-only and context-enhanced variants.

principles.principle: Trust and shared experience are stronger opening mechanisms than curiosity for trade business owners.
principles.evidence: CvC null result (curiosity failed). FF1 tests the alternative: founder observations as peer. Active experiment.

principles.principle: Customers do not buy because we follow up. They buy because they become more confident.
principles.evidence: Nicholas Zappacosta engaged after receiving personalised acknowledgment of his government tender — not from a follow-up sequence. Star Painters Adelaide converted through relationship, not cold email.
